event.effect_ceiling: one deterministic semantic claim; one duplicate-replay observation of existing claim while completion evidence is absent; one immutable event; one campaign decision; one pre-CURRENT pointer intent; one exact-v201 revalidation; one CURRENT update; one postread; one completion marker; one verification; zero external sends
event.evidence_class: exact v201 CURRENT verified; semantic claim created and read back; duplicate replay observed same existing claim while completion marker absent and CURRENT remained v201; exact v201 pre-update revalidation required; postread v202 required
event.honest_flaw: Claim-plus-completion reconciliation is application-level and non-atomic: a crash can leave a valid claim without a completion marker, and version-anchored keys split deduplication across versions. This wake is sequential and does not prove true concurrent writer safety.
event.rollback: Fail closed before CURRENT if claim semantics, duplicate-replay classification, pointer intent, or exact-v201 revalidation mismatch; after v202 use forward correction only; a claim without completion evidence is pending/reconcilable, not completed.
